title: CLAUDE.md
text: plot2 high-level R wrapper around ggplot2 designed minimise typing producing complex, publication-ready plots. central idea: one call plot2() replaces many separate ggplot2 + dplyr/tidyr steps, including automatic plot-type selection, -line data transformations, axis handling, custom theming. text: colour sets colours plot, whatever type. ggplot2 distinguishes colour aesthetic (points lines) fill aesthetic (areas bars), scale functions. plot2() determines two applies sets needed. text: plot2() applies theme_minimal2() default. theme based ggplot2::theme_minimal(), fewer grid lines, white space legend top, suited print. theme argument sets another theme, theme = NULL uses default theme ggplot2:  partial theme, made ggplot2::theme(), added theme_minimal2(), given elements change:  arguments change frequent elements directly. background sets background colour, text_factor scales text, legend.position places legend:  options plot2.theme, plot2.colour_background, plot2.text_factor, plot2.colour_font_primary (title), plot2.colour_font_secondary (subtitle caption) plot2.colour_font_axis (axis titles) set defaults plots. ?plot2-options lists options.
